phases.title: Web Foundations — HTML & CSS
phases.description: The thing rendered in a browser. HTML defines structure (the bones), CSS defines presentation (the skin).

topics.title: Fundamentals of HTML
topics.desc: semantic tags, document structure, links, images, forms

lesson.def:
HTML is the language of structure. You write **tags** like

(a top-level heading),

(paragraph), (a link). The browser parses these into a tree called the **DOM**, then renders that tree to pixels.

example.purpose: Six tags become a renderable page: a tab title, a heading, a paragraph, and a clickable link.

fp.q: Why use semantic tags like `<article>` instead of `<div>` everywhere?
fp.a: Screen readers and search engines need to know what a chunk of content IS. `<article>` says 'independent piece of content'; `<div>` says nothing.
